steps.title: Open Desk to see the Referee panels
steps.narration: Navigate to the Desk page where all three Referee sections are now visible.
steps.point_out: The Desk heading appears with the navigation bar showing Cockpit, Structure, and Desk.

steps.title: Scroll down to see the three Referee sections
steps.narration: Scroll to the bottom of the page to find the newly added Referee Adjudications and Referee Runs sections.
steps.point_out: Three section headers appear in order: Referee Registry, Referee Adjudications, and Referee Runs (all collapsed).

steps.title: Expand Referee Adjudications to see hypothesis verdicts
steps.narration: Click the Referee Adjudications section header to reveal registered hypotheses and their verdict chips.
steps.point_out: The section expands to show a disclosure paragraph about statistical verdicts, followed by hypothesis rows with verdict chips.

steps.title: Review verdict vocabulary and provenance
steps.narration: Examine the verdict chip for any hypothesis—each shows one of seven vocabulary words and full evidentiary provenance.
steps.point_out: Verdict chips display words like 'registered' or 'insufficient_sample' in plain text, with provenance lines showing basis hash, spec ids, seed identity, and attestation status.

steps.title: Expand Referee Runs to see compute controls and ledgers
steps.narration: Click the Referee Runs section header to reveal null-build and evaluation compute triggers with their run history tables.
steps.point_out: Two sub-blocks appear: 'Null Builds' with a build control per null spec, and 'Evaluations' with a control per hypothesis, each showing their run ledger below.

steps.title: Verify Referee Registry remains unchanged
steps.narration: Scroll back up and check that the pre-existing Referee Registry section still renders its registered hypotheses shortlist without any changes.
steps.point_out: The Referee Registry section above the new sections displays its original 5-row shortlist table and Registered Hypotheses table unchanged.

steps.title: Check that Playbook Evidence renders correctly
steps.narration: Scroll up further and expand the Playbook Evidence section to confirm it still displays setup signal data without regression.
steps.point_out: The Playbook Evidence section expands to show its signal table, basis block, and cohort views rendering real data.

steps.title: Verify Cockpit page still works
steps.narration: Navigate to the Cockpit page to confirm that this iteration's backend and frontend changes did not regress the product's other kept pages.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit page loads with its chart visible, nav bar showing Cockpit/Structure/Desk, and no error messages.
